task: Predict how many distinct, previously unreported physical target instances first enter a valid report viewpoint along a legal equal-budget candidate motion. Known instances already reportable at departure are excluded. No approximate report is issued by the head.
visible_evidence: Frozen OpenCLIP RN50 observed images only; three conventional CLIP crop features for V5/V6 JEPA, and 7x7 local value/output-projected RN50 features to learn target foreground and conditional depth <=2m. No ground truth segmentation, depth, future images, object ID, or query_present category flags at online inference.
split: Original 12 HSSD training and four calibration houses. A third set of four untouched HSSD houses is reserved solely for testing. Main comparison uses nine fixed, goal-independent motion templates on each start. Independently supplied original frontier candidates and Blender interventions are reported separately when available.
models: Train four parameter-matched route readouts: candidate geometry only, observed dense target evidence plus geometry, frozen JEPA target-conditioned regional prediction plus geometry, and the joint model. Each learns the same opportunity, future close-visibility, and traversability auxiliaries. Freeze a single joint-model checkpoint based only on calibration. Include pure displacement, frozen V6, wrong goal, and the same joint model with the future replaced with the nearest real observed embedding.
label_and_loss: Train dense current-image grounding with target pixel occupancy and near/conditional occupancy, using deterministic seed 83, twelve fixed epochs, balanced binary cross entropy, on all curated class labels for real training frames. Balanced sampling retains original/primitive action families and zero-gain rows. The route objective combines reported-opportunity binary classification and pairwise ranking over all legal forks, an additional nominal-geometry matched goal interaction loss, supervision for future near-target pixels, and forward-command success. Same route, sensor and score-difference gate for all model arms.
selection: Choose route epoch from 4,8,12 using only the old four calibration houses. All heads share this epoch. Rank epochs by the minimum primitive-panel gain margin of correct versus max(wrong, observed-only trained arm, pure displacement) across official vs derived domains. Tie break higher joint gain averaged across domains, then earlier epoch. No reweighting/selection on test. Keep common gate of a strict 0.01 advantage after sigmoid.
independent_gate: For the third fixed four-house panel: require (i) official positive new-instance gain, (ii) official or derived calibrated joint model strictly exceeds its trained observed-aux control and JEPA-only control on the same domain, (iii) correct target strictly exceeds its within-start cyclic wrong-target control in both domains, (iv) joint strictly exceeds simple displacement and the learned geometry-only readout in at least one domain, (v) at least two houses have positive joint-minus-observed paired gain in this winning domain, (vi) on any domain with label-varying near-equal-geometry pairs, joint exceeds random half credit. If the full gate fails, do not claim a validated JEPA benefit or automatically pay for another round.
metrics: Keep all states, ties and zero-opportunity rows. Cycle candidate origins uniformly for HSSD because actual MOST reference is unavailable. Use budgets 4/12/24, equal weights across full and one/two/three historical views, combine horizons and masks per physical start then average houses. Measure paired candidate rank; report support and the double-difference on matched opposite-target pairs. Use same paths for all arms.
